{{Quote|Crion!|Qui-Gon Jinn prior to killing Crion|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi—The Dark Side">''[[Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
A '''mission''' to [[Telos IV]] was undertaken by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Tahl]], Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Xanatos]], and the Masterless Padawan [[Orykan Tamarik]] in [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]].

==Prelude==
For some time, many members of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], including [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], had expressed their concerns about [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Xanatos]], and decided to give him one final test before granting him the title of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="DR">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref> Xanatos and Jinn were joined by two other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Tahl]] and [[Orykan Tamarik]], to undertake a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telos IV]].<ref name="Dark Side 1">[[Jedi — The Dark Side 1|''Jedi — The Dark Side'' 1]]</ref>

==The mission==
[[File:QuiGonKillsCrionJediTDS5.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jinn pushes Crion into the fire.]]
When the Jedi arrived, they found out that Xanatos's father, [[Crion]], had become a tyrant of the planet, abusing his power as [[Governor/Legends|governor]].<ref name="DR" /> After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his sister [[Nason]],<ref name="Dark Side 3">[[Jedi — The Dark Side 3|''Jedi — The Dark Side'' 3]]</ref> Xanatos was tempted by his father's power and wealth and joined him to rule the planet. This lead the planet to a [[Telosian Civil War|civil war]].<ref name="DR" />

Crion was confronted by Jinn, who accidentally killed the governor to save Tamarik.<ref name="Dark Side 5">[[Jedi — The Dark Side 5|''Jedi — The Dark Side'' 5]]</ref> Witnessing his father's death, Xanatos became enraged and took a ring from Crion's finger, searing hot from the fire he fell in. He branded it into his cheek, creating a broken-circle scar. Swearing his revenge, Xanatos fled.<ref name="DR" />

==Aftermath==
Jinn returned to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and blamed himself for Xanatos's failure, renouncing his success in training his first Padawan.<ref name="DR" />
